deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a mathematical worksheet. It is a heavily corrected pencil draft of a letter, written on the back of a Bremen post-office freight form (Frachtzettel): the printed headers 'No. der Karte', 'Zeichen', 'Stück', 'Pfund', 'Loth' are visible, and the next page is the front of the form. It continues the letter begun on the previous page ('Hochgeehrter Herr Doctor'). Almost certainly the addressee is C. W. Borchardt, editor of Crelle's Journal, and the context is the submission of 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). That paper was preceded in print by three short preparatory papers. (1) Allgemeine Voraussetzungen und Hülfsmittel für die Untersuchung von Functionen unbeschränkt veränderlicher Grössen. (2) Lehrsätze aus der analysis situs für die Theorie der Integrale von zweigliedrigen vollständigen Differentialien. (3) Bestimmung einer Function einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse durch Grenz- und Unstetigkeitsbedingungen.

Content of the draft, in order:
(a) The dissertation. Riemann says his Inauguraldissertation (1851) has, it seems to him, become dispensable through these three small papers. He thanks the editor for the offer to reprint it, but in effect prefers that these papers be printed instead.
(b) Copies of the dissertation. If anyone wishes a copy, he has a sufficient supply at disposal. He would send the editor copies if he had them on commission, and will ask the Dieterich bookshop in Göttingen to make them obtainable.
(c) Corrections to the manuscript sent on 18 May. The changes concern the second paper (analysis situs). The passage 'Bekanntlich ist dann ∫(X dx + Y dy) durch die ganze Begrenzung eines Theils der Fläche T allenthalben gegen diesen in derselben Richtung ... erstreckt = 0' is to be replaced by 'Bekanntlich ist dann ∫(X dx + Y dy) um einen Theil der Fläche T [erstreckt = 0]'.
(d) An announcement. The (apparently now appearing) first part of the 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' contains the elaboration of §§1–3 of the submitted paper. Its content is §§1, 2 and the part of §3 concerning elliptic functions; a reference to 'Gelehrten [Anzeigen?]' is possible.
(e) At the bottom there are faint upside-down lines and numbers, apparently unrelated jottings or tallies; they are illegible.

The only mathematical statement on the page is the one in (c). In modern form: let X, Y be continuous on a region of the surface T with ∂X/∂y = ∂Y/∂x, i.e. X dx + Y dy is a closed (locally exact) differential. Then the integral of X dx + Y dy over the full boundary of any portion of T is 0. This is the Green's-theorem lemma on which the analysis-situs paper (connectivity, cross-cuts, periodicity moduli) is built. The correction is purely one of wording. It replaces the clumsy specification of the orientation ('allenthalben gegen diesen in derselben Richtung') with the simpler 'um einen Theil der Fläche T'. No derivation is performed.
errors: No mathematical errors. The cited statement is correct under the implicit hypothesis ∂X/∂y = ∂Y/∂x with continuity on the closed portion, and the boundary must be taken with consistent orientation; that is exactly what the deleted wording tried to express.

results.what: If X dx + Y dy is a closed differential (∂X/∂y = ∂Y/∂x) on a portion of the Riemann surface T, its integral around the whole boundary of that portion is zero; used as the basis of the analysis-situs lemmas.
results.modern_name: Green's theorem / Cauchy integral theorem for closed 1-forms
results.usually_credited_to: Green (1828), Cauchy (1825); Riemann's use in Crelle 54 (1857)

results.what: Editorial/biographical information: the three preparatory papers of Crelle 54 are presented as replacing a reprint of the 1851 dissertation; manuscript sent on 18 May [1857]; copies of the dissertation via Dieterich in Göttingen.
results.modern_name: Correspondence with Borchardt regarding publication of Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen

deep.surprise_reason: This is a letter draft about publication logistics and a wording correction to a known published lemma. It has minor biographical interest: the date 18 May, the dissertation being superseded by the three short papers, and the Dieterich distribution. There is no new mathematics.

checkable.asserts: For a closed differential (∂X/∂y=∂Y/∂x) the integral around the boundary of a region (unit circle) is 0.
Green's theorem counterpart: when ∂Y/∂x-∂X/∂y ≠ 0 the boundary integral equals the area integral (2*pi here), showing the hypothesis is needed.

transcription_corrections: First line likely reads 'Meine Inauguraldissertation ist, wie mich scheint, durch diese drei kleinen Abhandlungen entbehrlich geworden' — 'Zweigwerthigkeitsarbeiten' is a misreading of 'Inauguraldissertation'.
'Dieterich' readings are plausible (Dieterich'sche Buchhandlung, Göttingen); the phrase may be 'noch meinen Buchhändler Dieterich darum fragen'.
The correction concerns the 'zweiten Abhandlung' (Lehrsätze aus der analysis situs) in Crelle 54; the quoted text 'erstreckt = 0' should be kept as the end of the original sentence.
Bottom upside-down lines are illegible pencil jottings/numbers, likely unrelated to the letter.
